releases.name: Release v0.21.0
releases.notes:
Release v0.21.0

## What's Changed

A varient of bug fixes, ongoing work on android boot.

Most notable change here is we no longer require `bwrap` in the target image; we now rely just on `util-linux`.

Thanks to all contributors!

* chore(deps): update github/gh-aw-actions action to v0.89.15 by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/360
* to-disk: Switch to a minimal boot target for to-disk installation by @petracvv in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/370
* chore(deps): update rust by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/373
* fix(deps): update bootc-utils digest to 65321ae by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/372
* fix(deps): update bootc-mount digest to 65321ae by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/371
* build: Upgrade gh-aw to  by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/362
* Include bootloader in disk cache calculation by @jeckersb in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/375
* run-ephemeral: Use cloud-init=disabled instead of ds=None by @jeckersb in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/379
* fix(deps): update bootc-mount digest to 83d1589 by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/380
* chore(deps): update github actions by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/383
* ssh: Raise ConnectTimeout so slow guests don't fail after readiness by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/377
* ephemeral: Mask bootloader-update.service by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/376
* chore(deps): update rust by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/382
* fix(deps): update bootc-utils digest to 83d1589 by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/381
* ephemeral: Preserve stdin for an interactive console by @alexlarsson in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/387
* Preparations for aboot support by @alexlarsson in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/388
* ephemeral: Don't pass -q to mkswap by @Jannik2099 in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/391
* nextest: Also serialize the test_to_base_disk_* tests by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/392
* ephemeral: Add test-basic subcommand by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/393
* ephemeral: Make swap enable before sshd by @alexlarsson in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/390
* libvirt: Retry virsh when the session daemon is restarting by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/394
* ephemeral: Explain when podman can't see bcvk's filesystem by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/389
* libvirt: Don't reuse a stale secure boot VARS template by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/378
* ephemeral: Drop bwrap, just mount and chroot into the hybrid root by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/395
* Add support for aboot images and aarch64 by @alexlarsson in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/385
* chore(deps): update rust by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/400
* Use published, versioned bootc internal crates by @jeckersb in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/403
* Release 0.21.0 by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/402

releases.notes:
Release v0.8.0

No major changes, just one SELinux fix for virtiofsd to increase compatibility with using it for container storage, and one to support running on Arch Linux.

## What's Changed
* Sync common files from infra repository by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/152
* virtiofs: Set SELinux context on readonly mounts by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/159
* build-sys: Try testing alma 10.0 instead by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/155
* virtiofsd_paths: Extends virtiofsd binary locations by @loacker-dev in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/163
* ephemeral: Add an option to override the entrypoint by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/149
* Release 0.8.0 by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/160

## New Contributors
* @loacker-dev made their first contribution in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/163

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0

## Installation

Download the appropriate binary for your platform from the assets below.

### Linux x86_64 (glibc)
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/releases/download/v0.8.0/bcvk-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
tar xzf bcvk-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
sudo mv bcvk-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu /usr/local/bin/bcvk
```


## Checksums

Verify the integrity of your download with the provided SHA256 checksums.
